name: bespunky
description: The BeSpunky toolkit front door. /bespunky:index is a self-maintaining catalog of every installed toolkit skill, grouped by plugin with its invocation and a one-line 'use when', read from the live skill set so it never goes stale. Typing /bespunky in the slash menu filters to the whole toolkit. Also rotates a few tips for installed toolkit plugins into Claude Code's working spinner; turn them off, on or list them with /bespunky:tips.
